lore.common: Sits in the bread bin with two crusty ends that nobody wants to eat.
lore.uncommon: Goes stale on one side while the other side is still soft.
lore.rare: Rises again in the bag every night, so the loaf is a little taller every morning and never fits the bread bin.
lore.epic: Was sliced so thin for a picnic that the wind blew the sandwiches into the next field, and the cows had lunch.
lore.legendary: Stayed fresh for a whole year out of pure stubbornness, then went stale the second someone wanted a sandwich.

lore.common: Has stripes across its top from the hot press, like a tiny zebra.
lore.uncommon: Oozes cheese from its edges onto the plate and the fingers.
lore.rare: Pulls the cheese out of every other sandwich in the cafe to fill itself up.
lore.epic: Stretched its cheese so far at lunch that two friends were joined across the table.
lore.legendary: Was pressed so hard in the grill that it came out thinner than a page, and it was posted to Gran as a birthday card.

names.legendary: Picnicus, the Roll That Ate a Picnic

lore.common: Holds its filling for exactly one bite before it starts to escape.
lore.uncommon: Covers everyone who eats it in a fine layer of crumbs.
lore.rare: Swaps its filling with the roll next to it in the lunchbox, so ham becomes jam by lunchtime.
lore.epic: Was sat on by Dad on the coach, came out flat as a pancake, and the family ate it rolled up like a carpet.
lore.legendary: Was stuffed so full that the whole picnic fitted inside it, blanket included, and the ants needed a map to find the jam.

lore.common: Has a layer of icing on top that everyone wants to lick off first.
lore.uncommon: Sinks a little in the middle, no matter how carefully it's baked.
lore.rare: Makes whoever cuts it sing 'Happy Birthday', even when it is nobody's birthday.
lore.epic: Leaned so far on the way to the table that it toppled onto the dog, who wore it as a hat for the rest of the party.
lore.legendary: Was baked with so many layers that the top one had its own weather, and the candles had to be lit from a ladder.

lore.common: Stands on a cake and waits for one big puff and a wish.
lore.uncommon: Drips coloured wax onto the icing every time it's lit for too long.
lore.rare: Comes back to life after being blown out, and everyone has to blow again.
lore.epic: Was blown out so hard that the wish flew into the next room and came true for the cat.
lore.legendary: Was blown out with a wish for 'more birthdays', and now the family has one every Tuesday.

lore.common: Is a ball of cake on a stick, covered in shiny icing and sprinkles.
lore.uncommon: Falls off its stick when bitten too hard.
lore.rare: Sends its sprinkles marching off in a line across the table whenever nobody is watching.
lore.epic: Got its stick tangled in the birthday girl's hair, and she wore it as a hair clip all afternoon.
lore.legendary: Popped so high off its stick that it went into orbit, and on clear nights it twinkles with sprinkles.

names.legendary: The Sweet That Was Shared Fairly

lore.common: Comes in a crinkly wrapper that is impossible to open quietly.
lore.uncommon: Has its wrapper twisted so tightly that it takes a whole film to open.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who eats one talk in a squeaky voice for exactly one minute.
lore.epic: Burst out of a pinata in such a rainbow that the garden looked like a sweet hailstorm, and the umbrellas came out.
lore.legendary: Was shared so fairly between six children that nobody argued, and all the parents fainted in shock.

lore.common: Is gooey and golden and sticks to the wrapper as it's opened.
lore.uncommon: Glues jaws together so firmly that nobody can talk for a minute.
lore.rare: Stretches so far when bitten that it becomes a long golden thread.
lore.epic: Stuck so many fingers together at a party that everyone held hands by accident.
lore.legendary: Melted into a golden puddle so big that the town skated on it once it set, and everyone's skates stuck.

lore.common: Gets chewed until it loses its flavour, then chewed for a bit longer anyway.
lore.uncommon: Ends up stuck under a desk, a shoe or a cinema seat.
lore.rare: Sticks itself back under the same desk no matter how many times it is scraped off.
lore.epic: Blew a bubble so big in assembly that it popped and stuck the front row's hair together.
lore.legendary: Blew a bubble so huge that it lifted its chewer off the playground, and the school had to reel him back in on a kite string.

lore.common: Wobbles when it's held up and squishes when it's bitten.
lore.uncommon: Sticks together in a big lump with all the other gummies in the bag.
lore.rare: Wobbles off the table on its own when nobody is looking and hides in the sofa cushions.
lore.epic: Was squeezed so hard that it shot out of its eater's fingers and stuck to the classroom ceiling, where it still wobbles.
lore.legendary: Squished itself flat to slip under the door, popped back into a bear on the other side, and the bag never saw it again.

names.legendary: The Bean That Was Every Flavour

lore.common: Comes in every colour, and nobody can guess what any of them taste like.
lore.uncommon: Always has one flavour that nobody likes, left at the bottom of the bag.
lore.rare: Changes flavour halfway through being chewed, so strawberry becomes sprout without warning.
lore.epic: Spilled out of the jar across the school hall, and the whole assembly slid about like a disco.
lore.legendary: Tasted of every flavour at once, and nobody could ever agree what it was.

lore.common: Is black and chewy and makes everybody's tongue go dark.
lore.uncommon: Is either loved or hated, with nobody in between.
lore.rare: Ties itself into knots in the bag, so getting one out takes a whole car journey.
lore.epic: Was used as a skipping rope at break, and the rope got shorter every turn because somebody kept nibbling it.
lore.legendary: Turned every tongue in town black for a week, so the school photo looks like a row of happy panthers.

names.legendary: The Lolly Bigger Than a Face

lore.common: Has a big rainbow swirl on a stick and lasts for hours.
lore.uncommon: Gets fluff and hair stuck on it the moment it's put down.
lore.rare: Hypnotises anyone who stares at its swirl, so the whole queue at the fair walks round in circles.
lore.epic: Was dropped on the fairground carousel and stuck so firmly that it now goes round with the horses.
lore.legendary: Was so big that its owner hid behind it during a game of hide and seek.

lore.common: Makes breath cool and fresh and the whole mouth tingle.
lore.uncommon: Gets offered round after every dinner whether anyone wants one or not.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who eats it whistle by accident on every word with an S in it.
lore.epic: Was passed round after dinner, and the whole table breathed out so coldly that the candles froze.
lore.legendary: Was crunched so loudly at a quiet dinner that the sound froze in the air, and the guests hung their coats on it.

lore.common: Is hard and golden and needs a little hammer to break it.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck to its own wrapper, so half of every piece is eaten with a bit of paper.
lore.rare: Shatters like glass when tapped, and the pieces fly so far that the hammer has to wear goggles.
lore.epic: Was so hard that it broke the little hammer, then the big hammer, then the neighbour's hammer.
lore.legendary: Was so hard that it outlasted the castle wall it was stuck to, and the builders now order it by the tonne.

names.legendary: Ganache Grande, Owner of the Shop

lore.common: Is a little ball of chocolate dusted with cocoa that melts on fingers.
lore.uncommon: Hides a surprise filling inside its shell, so the strawberry one always turns out to be coffee.
lore.rare: Melts on purpose in the hand of anyone who is about to share it.
lore.epic: Was the last truffle in the box, and the family argued so long that it got bored and ate itself.
lore.legendary: Was so rich that it bought the chocolate shop it came from and handed out free samples on its first day as owner.

lore.common: Has a crackly top and a gooey middle that sticks to the tin.
lore.uncommon: Has corners that are fought over and a middle that falls apart.
lore.rare: Grows a crispy corner wherever it is cut, so there is never a middle piece.
lore.epic: Was baked so gooey for the bake sale that the tray slid off the table and set as a chocolate path across the hall.
lore.legendary: Was so gooey in the middle that a teaspoon fell in and came out on the other side of the world.

lore.common: Snaps into neat squares and melts on warm fingers.
lore.uncommon: Melts in the pocket into a puddle that ruins a pair of trousers.
lore.rare: Melts only for its owner, and stays rock hard in the hand of anyone trying to pinch a square.
lore.epic: Melted on the classroom radiator and dripped into the shape of the teacher's face, smiling for once.
lore.legendary: Snapped into so many squares that it tiled the whole kitchen floor, and the family ate its way to the fridge.

lore.common: Is soft and crumbly and so sweet that it makes teeth tingle.
lore.uncommon: Crumbles into pieces when it's cut, so nobody gets a neat square.
lore.rare: Turns any spoon left in it into fudge, so the cutlery drawer is slowly becoming pudding.
lore.epic: Was sold on the pier in a slab so heavy that the pier tilted, and the fishing boats got a free sample.
lore.legendary: Was so sweet that the sea round the pier turned to syrup, and the waves now break in slow motion.

lore.common: Has chocolate chips scattered through it and crumbs that go everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Breaks in half in the milk and sinks to the bottom.
lore.rare: Hides its chocolate chips whenever anyone counts them, so every cookie seems to have just one.
lore.epic: Crumbled so badly on a train that the pigeons at every station knew which carriage to wait at.
lore.legendary: Was baked so big and round that it was mistaken for a full moon, and the wolves howled at it all night.

lore.common: Has a tiny paper message inside that is never quite what anyone expected.
lore.uncommon: Snaps so loudly when opened that it makes the whole table jump.
lore.rare: Makes its fortunes come true, but only the small ones, so 'you will find treasure' means a coin under the sofa.
lore.epic: Gave the whole table the fortune 'look behind you', and they all turned round at once and knocked over the noodles.
lore.legendary: Predicted rain on sports day so firmly that the clouds felt they had to turn up.

lore.common: Has icing buttons down his front and a big smile on his face.
lore.uncommon: Loses a leg first, always, whenever someone takes a bite.
lore.rare: Bakes himself a little friend out of his own crumbs whenever someone takes a bite.
lore.epic: Led a whole tray of gingerbread on a getaway across the kitchen, and the fox from the story asked them for directions.
lore.legendary: Ran so far that he outran the fox, the river and the end of his own story, and the last page is still blank.

lore.common: Is a pastel-coloured little sandwich with a crisp shell and a soft middle.
lore.uncommon: Crumbles all over the plate the moment it's picked up.
lore.rare: Has a shell so delicate that it cracks if anyone so much as says 'crunch' nearby.
lore.epic: Was stacked into a tower at a fancy tea, and one sneeze sent the whole rainbow rolling under the piano.
lore.legendary: Was mistaken for a famous painting, and now it hangs in a gallery with a guard watching it slowly soften.

lore.common: Is a flat shiny biscuit covered in icing and sprinkles.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a trail of sprinkles wherever it goes.
lore.rare: Rearranges its own icing when nobody is looking, so the smiley face is a frowny face by teatime.
lore.epic: Was iced so thickly at a party that it turned into a skateboard, and the birthday boy rode it to the bus stop.
lore.legendary: Was cut into a star so perfect that it floated up into the night sky, and there is now a constellation that smells of vanilla.

lore.common: Has thin crispy layers with sweet cream in between.
lore.uncommon: Snaps into a shower of crumbs when bitten.
lore.rare: Plays a different note for every layer when tapped, like a tiny xylophone.
lore.epic: Snapped so loudly in a quiet cinema that the film stopped, rewound and started again from the beginning.
lore.legendary: Was stacked into a tower so tall that the harbour used it as a lighthouse until a hungry storm ate it.

lore.common: Is curved like a moon and leaves buttery flakes on every shirt.
lore.uncommon: Sheds one flake into every keyboard, pocket and car seat it passes.
lore.rare: Points its horns at whoever ate the last one, so nobody can pretend it wasn't them.
lore.epic: Covered a whole cafe table in flakes at breakfast, and the birds came to the window.
lore.legendary: Was so buttery that it slid out of the bakery, down the high street and into the harbour, where it is now a boat.

lore.common: Has a swirl of icing on top that's bigger than the cake underneath.
lore.uncommon: Leaves icing on the nose of whoever bites it first.
lore.rare: Puffs out a cloud of icing sugar when bitten, and its eater sneezes sprinkles.
lore.epic: Was stacked in a party tower, and when someone took one from the bottom, the whole tower rained onto the bouncy castle.
lore.legendary: Had icing so tall that a mountaineer climbed it, planted a flag and had to be rescued with a teaspoon.

lore.common: Has a hole in the middle and sugar that covers every finger.
lore.uncommon: Squirts jam out of its side with the first bite.
lore.rare: Rolls away on its edge like a wheel whenever someone reaches for it.
lore.epic: Was dunked in hot chocolate and floated round the mug like a rubber ring, with a marshmallow sunbathing in the middle.
lore.legendary: Was so big that the town turned it into a roundabout, and the cars go round it licking their lips.

lore.common: Spreads across the pan until it touches the sausages, then refuses to let go.
lore.uncommon: Breaks its yolk the moment it's flipped.
lore.rare: Shines its yolk like a little torch, so it can be found in a dark kitchen at midnight.
lore.epic: Was flipped so high that it landed on the cat's head.
lore.legendary: Shone its yolk so brightly at breakfast that the sun thought it had been replaced and went back to bed.

lore.common: Folds over its filling like a yellow blanket.
lore.uncommon: Tears in half when it's flipped, so it turns into scrambled eggs.
lore.rare: Folds itself over anything left on the plate, so the peas, the fork and the salt cellar all get tucked in.
lore.epic: Was flipped so hard in a cafe that it wrapped itself round the chef like a yellow scarf.
lore.legendary: Was cooked in a pan so big that the whole town used it as a duvet on the coldest night of the year.

lore.common: Is soft and yellow and sticks to the pan if it isn't stirred.
lore.uncommon: Gets cold so quickly that the toast is always warmer.
lore.rare: Scrambles anything near the pan, so the shopping list and the crossword come out jumbled.
lore.epic: Was made with so many eggs that the hens next door went on strike until they got a thank-you card.
lore.legendary: Was scrambled so fast that it unscrambled itself back into twelve whole eggs, and the cook had to start again.

lore.common: Come in a paper cone, crispy on the outside and soft in the middle.
lore.uncommon: Get stolen one by one by whoever is sitting nearest.
lore.rare: Points like a compass at the nearest bottle of ketchup, even in someone else's house.
lore.epic: Were stolen by a seagull on the seafront, and the whole beach chased it.
lore.legendary: Stayed hot for the walk home, then for the whole winter, and the family used the cone as a heater.

lore.common: Swirls into a cup and gets covered in toppings until it disappears.
lore.uncommon: Melts faster than its toppings can be eaten.
lore.rare: Gives anyone who eats it too fast a brain freeze so strong that they forget what day it is.
lore.epic: Swirled out of the machine without stopping, and the morning staff had to dig their way into the shop.
lore.legendary: Was swirled so tall that snow settled on top, and a skier came down it with chocolate flakes on his hat.

lore.common: Comes in a little cup with a tiny spade-shaped spoon.
lore.uncommon: Comes with a spoon so tiny that eating it takes longer than the holiday.
lore.rare: Changes flavour to match the weather, so a rainy day gets a scoop of puddle.
lore.epic: Was served in a cup so big that the family had to hire a pedalo to reach the bottom.
lore.legendary: Was so good that a family missed their flight home, and they now live above the gelato shop.

lore.common: Has a scoop of ice cream on a cone that starts to drip at once.
lore.uncommon: Falls off the cone at the very first lick and lands scoop-side down.
lore.rare: Drips only on whoever is wearing their best clothes, and it can find them across a whole beach.
lore.epic: Melted into a river on the hottest day, and a family of ducks paddled away in the empty cone.
lore.legendary: Was piled with so many scoops that the cone reached the clouds, and every cloud over town now tastes of strawberry.

lore.common: Has scoops of ice cream, sauce and a cherry, all in a tall glass.
lore.uncommon: Has a cherry on top that everyone wants and nobody shares.
lore.rare: Puts a cherry on top of anything near it, so the soup, the homework and Dad's head all get one.
lore.epic: Toppled at the ice-cream parlour and buried the counter, and the staff dug out two spoons and a surprised waiter.
lore.legendary: Was so tall that the girl eating it started at breakfast and reached the bottom on her birthday.

lore.common: Holds a slice of pizza that flops when it's picked up.
lore.uncommon: Always has one slice with all the olives, and it is always the one left at the end.
lore.rare: Turns any box stacked on it into pizza, so the shoe box and the cereal box now come with cheese.
lore.epic: Was left on a car roof and flew off down the road like a frisbee, and a lorry driver caught it with one hand.
lore.legendary: Folded itself into a paper aeroplane and delivered its own pizza across town before the shop had even picked up the phone.

lore.common: Pops in the pan and fills the kitchen with a lovely buttery smell.
lore.uncommon: Spills on the sofa and stays in the cushions for weeks.
lore.rare: Hides one unpopped kernel in every handful, waiting for the softest tooth.
lore.epic: Spilled all over the lounge on film night, and the dog had the best evening of its life.
lore.legendary: Kept popping after the bag was empty until the kitchen was full to the ceiling, and the family had to eat its way out.

lore.common: Is wrapped in warm pita bread with sauce dripping down the side.
lore.uncommon: Hides a few chips inside its pita, and one always falls out first.
lore.rare: Gets wrapped so tightly that the last bite squirts sauce right up its eater's sleeve.
lore.epic: Was wrapped so tight at a festival that it popped like a party cracker and showered the stage with lettuce.
lore.legendary: Held so much sauce that when it finally burst, it painted the festival field white and the planes thought it had snowed.

lore.common: Is a folded tortilla full of melted cheese, cut into wedges.
lore.uncommon: Lets one wedge slide off the plate every time it is carried to the table.
lore.rare: Hides a pocket of molten cheese in its middle wedge, so whoever gets it gasps.
lore.epic: Folded so hard that it snapped shut on the spatula and wouldn't let go until it got more cheese.
lore.legendary: Was so crispy that its crunch was heard across the desert, and a camel came to ask for a wedge.

lore.common: Is sliced from a big turning spit and wrapped with salad and sauce.
lore.uncommon: Drips garlic sauce on the floor with every bite.
lore.rare: Turns on its spit so hypnotically that the whole queue forgets what it was going to order.
lore.epic: Was so garlicky that the vampire film on the takeaway's TV switched itself off.
lore.legendary: Grew on its spit until it was as tall as the shop, and the owner now climbs a ladder to slice the top.

lore.common: Crunches loudly at the first bite and then falls apart completely.
lore.uncommon: Drops its filling on the plate after every bite.
lore.rare: Holds its shape only while someone is looking at it, and folds flat the moment its eater blinks.
lore.epic: Crunched so loudly at taco night that the smoke alarm went off and the dog hid in the bath.
lore.legendary: Was folded so big that a whole family slept inside it on a camping trip, with a zip made of cheese.

lore.common: Is rolled tight with filling and wrapped in foil for lunch.
lore.uncommon: Unrolls at the worst moment and drops its filling on the desk.
lore.rare: Rolls itself tighter whenever anyone tries to take a bite, until it is as hard as a rolling pin.
lore.epic: Was wrapped in so much foil that it set off the airport scanner, and the whole queue waited while it was unwrapped.
lore.legendary: Wrapped itself round a runaway shopping trolley and stopped it at the bottom of the hill without losing a single pea.

lore.common: Has a crisscross top and smells of apples and cinnamon.
lore.uncommon: Burns the tongue of anyone who can't wait for it to cool.
lore.rare: Turns any apple left in the fruit bowl into a pie overnight, so the fruit bowl is now a pie dish.
lore.epic: Was left to cool on a windowsill, and three neighbours and a fox turned up to admire it.
lore.legendary: Had a crust so big that it became the roof of the village hall, and now the rain smells of cinnamon.

lore.common: Is soft and white and steamed until it's as squishy as a pillow.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to the paper underneath it and tears at the bottom.
lore.rare: Bounces back so hard when squeezed that it boings out of the steamer and onto the next table.
lore.epic: Was steamed so fluffy that the restaurant used it as a cushion, and two customers sat on their lunch.
lore.legendary: Rose in the steamer so high that it lifted the restaurant off the ground, and the waiters now serve lunch in parachutes.

lore.common: Rattles when it's picked up, which means there are still biscuits inside.
lore.uncommon: Has only broken biscuits and crumbs at the bottom when it's finally opened.
lore.rare: Holds sewing things whenever a child opens it, and biscuits whenever a grown-up does.
lore.epic: Was opened so hard at a family party that the lid rolled down the hall, out of the door and into next door's party.
lore.legendary: Was so hard to open that a crane and the strongest man in town both gave up, and Gran opened it with a teaspoon.

lore.common: Sits in its dish waiting for warm toast to melt into.
lore.uncommon: Is too hard to spread in the morning and tears every slice of bread.
lore.rare: Goes rock hard the moment anyone wants to spread it, and melts the moment they give up.
lore.epic: Was left out so long in summer that it slid off the table, out through the cat flap and down the garden.
lore.legendary: Spread so smoothly straight from the fridge that it buttered a whole loaf in one swipe, and the toaster gave a little bow.

lore.common: Is a pizza folded in half and sealed, hiding everything inside.
lore.uncommon: Lets out a puff of steam that burns the tongue of the first biter.
lore.rare: Hides a different pizza inside every time it is cut, so nobody ever knows what they ordered.
lore.epic: Erupted so much cheese when it was cut that the party moved into the garden and ate the lava with forks.
lore.legendary: Folded itself round a whole pizza restaurant, and the diners finished their meal inside without noticing.

lore.common: Is a pink cloud of sugar on a stick that melts on the tongue.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to every face, finger and hair that comes near it.
lore.rare: Spins any hair it touches into more candy floss, so the hairdresser now sells it by the bag.
lore.epic: Was blown off its stick at the seaside and wrapped the lifeguard's chair in pink, with the lifeguard still in it.
lore.legendary: Was spun so big at the fair that it became the new big top, and the circus moved in.

lore.common: Sits in the fridge and makes everything else smell slightly cheesy.
lore.uncommon: Grows a little dot of mould if it's forgotten at the back.
lore.rare: Ages a whole year every time the fridge door is opened, so it is now older than Grandad.
lore.epic: Was unwrapped on a train, and the whole carriage moved next door, leaving the cheese a first-class seat to itself.
lore.legendary: Smelled so strong that the harbour used it as a foghorn, and the ships now steer by nose.

lore.common: Is a triangle of cheese with holes all the way through it.
lore.uncommon: Has its pointy end eaten first by somebody who denies it.
lore.rare: Moves its holes around overnight, so the slice you cut is never the slice you expected.
lore.epic: Was put out for a picnic, and three mice arrived before the guests.
lore.legendary: Had so many holes that the wind whistled through it, and the town band now plays it as a flute.

lore.common: Has a crunchy biscuit base and a creamy top with berries on it.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to the knife whenever it's cut, so slices come out wobbly.
lore.rare: Weighs ten times more than it looks, so the waiter's tray tips over every time it is served.
lore.epic: Wobbled off its plate at a party and skied down the tablecloth into Grandad's lap.
lore.legendary: Was so rich and heavy that when it was dropped, the earthquake machine across town recorded a small cheesequake.

names.legendary: The Box That Was Never Empty

lore.common: Has a little map inside the lid that nobody ever reads properly.
lore.uncommon: Rustles loudly whenever someone sneaks a chocolate from it.
lore.rare: Swaps its chocolates round whenever someone checks the map, so the toffee is always the coffee one.
lore.epic: Was passed round a party so slowly that the person at the end found only the map and a coffee cream.
lore.legendary: Always seemed to have one more chocolate inside, no matter how many were taken.

lore.common: Is a long crispy stick covered in sugar and cinnamon.
lore.uncommon: Drops sugar on every shirt it comes near.
lore.rare: Grows longer every time it is dunked, so the last dip always needs a bigger cup.
lore.epic: Was so long and crisp that Grandad used it as a walking stick to the fair and back.
lore.legendary: Was piped so long at the fair that it went round the big wheel, and riders snapped off a piece as they passed.

lore.common: Is a soft swirl of dough with cinnamon and icing on top.
lore.uncommon: Unrolls itself into a long strip when it's eaten from the outside in.
lore.rare: Spins like a top when set down, and doesn't stop until somebody says 'cinnamon'.
lore.epic: Was baked on a Saturday morning, and the neighbours came round in their pyjamas.
lore.legendary: Unrolled itself into one ribbon of dough long enough to wrap the town hall like a present.

lore.common: Is a fluffy cloud of spun sugar that is mostly air.
lore.uncommon: Melts in the rain before it can be eaten.
lore.rare: Is so light that it floats in the air when it's let go.
lore.epic: Floated off at the carnival and got tangled round the trapeze, so the acrobats swung through a pink cloud all night.
lore.legendary: Drifted across the sea and was found by a lighthouse keeper two countries away, still on its stick.

lore.common: Is a crisp pastry ball filled with cream that escapes when it's bitten.
lore.uncommon: Collapses into a sad pancake if anyone opens the oven door too early.
lore.rare: Puffs itself up bigger whenever someone says it looks small.
lore.epic: Fired its cream across the room at a party and gave the portrait on the wall a beard.
lore.legendary: Was so light that it floated out of the bakery and became a weather balloon. Its forecast: cloudy, with a chance of cream.

lore.common: Gets rolled round lemon and sugar and is gone in about three bites.
lore.uncommon: Tears when it's folded too quickly.
lore.rare: Folds itself into any shape it is asked for, so the market stall now sells crepe swans.
lore.epic: Was folded so many times on pancake day that it became a paper fan and cooled the whole kitchen.
lore.legendary: Was so thin that it floated off the griddle like a magic carpet and gave the cook a ride round the market.

lore.common: Is warm and yellow and poured over pudding in a thick river.
lore.uncommon: Grows a skin on top if it's left to cool for a minute.
lore.rare: Grows lumps on purpose whenever anyone says 'no lumps, please'.
lore.epic: Was poured over a school pudding so thickly that the dinner lady lost her ladle in it until next term.
lore.legendary: Set its skin so thick that the children bounced across the bowl like a trampoline, and nobody fell in.

lore.common: Arrives at the meeting looking perfect and leaves it looking as if someone sat on it.
lore.uncommon: Leaves jam on the fingers of whoever picks it up.
lore.rare: Makes a whole meeting go quiet when its box is opened, while everyone eyes the cherry one.
lore.epic: Was opened at a big meeting, and the boss got so sticky that he signed every letter with his thumb.
lore.legendary: Shed so many layers in one bite that the flakes were swept up and baked into a second danish.

lore.common: Comes in little steaming baskets, each with a surprise inside.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to the bottom of the basket when it's picked up too fast.
lore.rare: Rolls its basket round the table by itself and stops in front of whoever is hungriest.
lore.epic: Was stacked so high on Sunday that the tower of baskets swayed like a tree, and the whole restaurant leaned to hold it up.
lore.legendary: Served one basket with a dumpling and a smaller basket inside, and so on all the way down to a single crumb.

lore.common: Holds a dozen donuts, each one more sprinkled than the last.
lore.uncommon: Gets opened and has the best donut taken before anyone else arrives.
lore.rare: Locks its lid whenever the person holding it says they'll only have one.
lore.epic: Was opened so fast in the office that the sprinkles shot into the printer, and every report came out decorated.
lore.legendary: Was so big that the office used it as the meeting table, and every meeting has finished early ever since.

lore.common: Has little folds along its top like a tiny pastry fan.
lore.uncommon: Splits open when it's boiled too long and loses its filling.
lore.rare: Pinches its pleats round the chopsticks and won't let go until it has been dipped in sauce.
lore.epic: Was folded at a family party into shapes so odd that one looked exactly like Grandad, and he refused to eat it.
lore.legendary: Had pleats so perfect that the curtain maker copied them, and now every window in town is dressed like a dumpling.

lore.common: Is a long pastry with cream inside and chocolate on top.
lore.uncommon: Squirts cream out of both ends when it's bitten in the middle.
lore.rare: Grows its chocolate topping back overnight, so somebody licks it off every evening.
lore.epic: Squirted so much cream at the bakery that the baker's hat turned into a meringue.
lore.legendary: Was so shiny that the bakery used it as a mirror, and the baker straightens his hat in it every morning.

lore.common: Is a folded pastry with a crimped edge and a spicy filling.
lore.uncommon: Has a crimped edge that is always the crunchiest bit and always the first to break off.
lore.rare: Crimps itself shut so tightly that only the person who made it can open it.
lore.epic: Was folded so big at the market that the stallholder used it as an umbrella when it rained.
lore.legendary: Was so spicy that one bite cleared every blocked nose in the market at once, and the tissue stall closed early.

lore.common: Is rolled up and baked in sauce and cheese until it bubbles.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck to the dish so hard that it needs soaking overnight.
lore.rare: Spreads its sauce onto anything nearby, so the oven gloves come out red and spicy.
lore.epic: Was baked in a tray too big for the oven, so the family cooked it on the car roof in the midday sun.
lore.legendary: Rolled so long in the oven that it came out of the back of the cooker and into the kitchen next door.

lore.common: Is a crunchy little ball that crumbles into a pita bread.
lore.uncommon: Rolls off the plate and away down the table whenever it isn't wrapped up.
lore.rare: Bounces like a rubber ball when dropped and has to be chased round the kitchen.
lore.epic: Was rolled so round at a festival that it was used in the football match and scored twice before it was eaten.
lore.legendary: Rolled out of its pita, down the hill and through the whole town like a crunchy snowball, picking up lettuce on the way.

lore.common: Is bread dipped in egg and fried until it's golden.
lore.uncommon: Soaks up so much syrup that it drips on the floor.
lore.rare: Soaks up any drink put near it, so the tea, the milk and the orange juice all go missing at breakfast.
lore.epic: Soaked up so much syrup that it slid off the plate and skated across the kitchen like an ice-hockey puck.
lore.legendary: Soaked up a whole lake of maple syrup in one slice, and the forest has been trying to get it back ever since.

names.legendary: The Bread That Scared Off Every Moth

lore.common: Smells so strongly of garlic that everyone in the house knows it's for dinner.
lore.uncommon: Drips butter on the plate and fingers with every bite.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who eats it whisper, because their breath can blow out a candle.
lore.epic: Was baked so garlicky that the holiday photos came out with green clouds round everyone's mouths.
lore.legendary: Smelled so strong that every moth in the house moved out for good.

names.legendary: The Gnocchi That Were Light as Clouds

lore.common: Are little potato pillows with lines pressed in with a fork.
lore.uncommon: Stick together in the pan if they're not stirred.
lore.rare: Multiplies in the pot, so a handful for two turns into dinner for the whole street.
lore.epic: Was rolled so big at a family party that one gnocchi became the baby's pillow.
lore.legendary: Were so light and fluffy that they floated to the top of the pan and waved.

lore.common: Is a bright cube of wobbly dessert that shakes when touched.
lore.uncommon: Slides off the spoon before it reaches the mouth.
lore.rare: Wobbles in time to any music in the room, and loses its rhythm completely when Dad sings.
lore.epic: Fell on the floor, bounced back onto the plate, and then did it again for an encore.
lore.legendary: Wobbled for so long after one tap that it was used to power the town clock, and the clock hands now wiggle.

lore.common: Comes out of its mould shaped like a rabbit, a castle or a fish.
lore.uncommon: Sinks a little when it's turned out, and the rabbit loses an ear.
lore.rare: Hops off the plate when it is shaped like a rabbit, and swims away when it is shaped like a fish.
lore.epic: Was turned out as a giant castle at a birthday party, and the toy soldiers defended it all afternoon before it fell.
lore.legendary: Was turned out so tall that it became the village's jelly mountain, and walkers now carry spoons instead of sticks.

lore.common: Is soft and squishy and puffs up when it's held near the fire.
lore.uncommon: Catches fire on the stick and needs blowing out.
lore.rare: Puffs up so big when it's toasted that it falls off the stick.
lore.epic: Was toasted so big at a campfire that it became a sleeping bag, and the scout leader slept in it.
lore.legendary: Toasted so golden that it outshone the campfire, and the campers roasted their sausages on it instead.

names.legendary: The Mousse That Was Lighter Than Air

lore.common: Is so light and fluffy that it barely sits on the spoon.
lore.uncommon: Collapses if it's left out too long on a warm day.
lore.rare: Makes everyone at the table speak in a hushed, fancy voice the moment it is served.
lore.epic: Drifted out of an open window at a fancy dinner and settled on the garden gnome like a chocolate hat.
lore.legendary: Was so light that it floated off the spoon and nearly up to the ceiling.

lore.common: Is the crispy top of a muffin that everyone wants to eat first.
lore.uncommon: Gets pulled off and eaten while the bottom is left on the plate.
lore.rare: Swells over the edge of the tin until it joins the muffin next door, so every batch comes out as one giant top.
lore.epic: Was pulled off every muffin at a party, and the abandoned bottoms formed a band and played a very sad song.
lore.legendary: Pulled itself off every muffin in the bakery and became one giant top, which now has a shop of its own.

lore.common: Are crunchy chips piled high with melted cheese and salsa.
lore.uncommon: Leave one chip at the bottom with no toppings at all.
lore.rare: Stretches its cheese between every chip, so picking up one lifts the whole plate.
lore.epic: Was piled so high on film night that it blocked the TV, and the family watched the film through a gap in the chips.
lore.legendary: Was piled so high that a mountain goat climbed it for the view and stayed for the guacamole.

lore.common: Is a pile of pancakes with butter and syrup dripping down its sides.
lore.uncommon: Leans to one side the higher it gets.
lore.rare: Is so tall that the top pancake is cold by the time it's reached.
lore.epic: Was flipped so high on pancake day that the top pancake landed on the washing line and dried in the sun.
lore.legendary: Was stacked so high that the top pancake had to be flipped by a passing helicopter.

lore.common: Has a hundred buttery layers that flake on every shirt.
lore.uncommon: Puffs up so much in the oven that it hides the filling completely.
lore.rare: Takes the shape of whatever it is draped over, so the baker now sells pastry hats, pastry shoes and a pastry cat.
lore.epic: Was rolled out so thin that the wind caught it like a sail and blew it out to sea.
lore.legendary: Puffed up so high in the oven that it became the bakery's golden dome, and pigeons nest in its flakes.

lore.common: Is a wedge of pie with a crispy crust and a filling that slides out.
lore.uncommon: Is always cut slightly bigger than everyone else's, and everyone notices.
lore.rare: Grows back into a whole pie if it is left on the plate overnight.
lore.epic: Was cut so badly at a party that the slice went one way, the filling went the other, and the crust went home with the dog.
lore.legendary: Was cut so exactly that the knife became the town's official ruler, and every road is now measured in pie slices.

lore.common: Wobbles in its dish and makes everyone hurry to finish their dinner.
lore.uncommon: Gets announced at the start of dinner, so nobody can concentrate on their peas.
lore.rare: Makes everyone at the table finish their vegetables just to get some.
lore.epic: Was so popular at Sunday lunch that the vegetables tried to hide inside it.
lore.legendary: Wobbled at exactly the right speed to rock a crying baby to sleep, and it now has a job at the nursery.

lore.common: Is a little square of pasta with a surprise filling inside.
lore.uncommon: Bursts open in the pan and loses its filling to the water.
lore.rare: Folds itself into a little parcel and posts itself to whoever is hungriest.
lore.epic: Got stuck together in one long chain, and the family pulled it out of the pan like a magician's scarf.
lore.legendary: Held a whole dinner in one pocket: soup, pasta and a tiny trifle at the very end.

lore.common: Is a crispy triangle full of spiced potatoes and peas.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a trail of crispy pastry crumbs from the plate to the sofa.
lore.rare: Sneezes a puff of spice in the face of anyone who calls it a pasty by mistake.
lore.epic: Was stacked into a pyramid at a party, and a tourist took a photo thinking it was the real thing.
lore.legendary: Was so perfectly triangular that it was used to mend the roof of a house, and the attic now smells of cumin.

lore.common: Is a sausage in flaky pastry that is always too hot inside and too cold outside.
lore.uncommon: Leaves its sausage behind in the bag and arrives at the picnic as an empty tube.
lore.rare: Disappears from any party plate so fast that the host never gets to eat one.
lore.epic: Was baked so long for the picnic that it became the finishing line for the sack race.
lore.legendary: Was baked in one piece long enough to go round the park, and the joggers nibble a bit each lap.

names.legendary: The Scone That Ended the Debate

lore.common: Is split in half and topped with jam and cream, or cream and jam.
lore.uncommon: Starts an argument about whether jam or cream goes first.
lore.rare: Splits itself in half the moment the jam jar is opened, ready to be filled.
lore.epic: Started such a jam-or-cream argument at a garden party that a fence was built down the middle of the field.
lore.legendary: Ended the argument about jam or cream by tasting perfect both ways.

lore.common: Is crispy and golden and crunches loudly with every bite.
lore.uncommon: Squirts hot filling when it's bitten too quickly.
lore.rare: Gets dunked in sweet chilli sauce so deep that the sauce pot needs refilling after every roll.
lore.epic: Unrolled in the fryer and came out as one long golden ribbon, which the family hung up as decorations.
lore.legendary: Crunched once so loudly that the sound rolled down the river, and the boats pulled over to let it pass.

lore.common: Is steamed inside a corn husk that has to be unwrapped like a present.
lore.uncommon: Gets eaten husk and all by someone who didn't know.
lore.rare: Keeps its filling so hot inside the husk that it is still steaming an hour after it is served.
lore.epic: Was made by the whole family in one day, and somebody wrapped Grandma's glasses in a husk and steamed them too.
lore.legendary: Was wrapped so many times that unwrapping it became the town's longest party game, and the last layer came off on New Year's Day.

names.legendary: The Tart That Shone Like Jewels

lore.common: Has a crispy pastry case and fruit on top that shines like jewels.
lore.uncommon: Rolls its top grape off the side whenever the plate is tilted.
lore.rare: Sets its glaze so hard that the fruit can be heard tapping on the inside to get out.
lore.epic: Shone so brightly in the bakery window that a magpie flew off with the whole tart, plate and all.
lore.legendary: Shone so brightly in the bakery window that people thought it was a jewellery shop.

lore.common: Has soft layers of sponge and cream with cocoa dusted on top.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone sneeze when the cocoa dust is blown.
lore.rare: Wakes anyone who eats it so thoroughly that they tidy their room at midnight.
lore.epic: Was dusted with so much cocoa that the dinner party sneezed in chorus and the tablecloth turned brown.
lore.legendary: Lifted the spirits of a gloomy rain cloud so well that it rained sprinkles over the town.

lore.common: Pops up from the toaster golden and ready for butter.
lore.uncommon: Gets burnt on one side every time it's left alone.
lore.rare: Grows its crusts back every time they are cut off, which annoys every child at breakfast.
lore.epic: Popped up so high that it landed on the cat, butter side up.
lore.legendary: Fell butter side up so often that it broke the law of buttered toast, and now the cat lands on its back instead.

lore.common: Has little squares that hold pools of syrup.
lore.uncommon: Overflows with syrup that runs onto the table.
lore.rare: Fills each square with a different topping by itself, and one square is always broccoli.
lore.epic: Was stacked into a tower so tall that children used the squares as a climbing wall.
lore.legendary: Was laid out so big on the beach that it became a giant game of noughts and crosses, and the tide always wins.

lore.common: Comes in a little pot with a lid that always gets licked.
lore.uncommon: Splashes onto the shirt when its lid is pulled off too fast.
lore.rare: Curdles any milk stored next to it, so the fridge door is full of very surprised cheese.
lore.epic: Exploded in a lunchbox and covered every sandwich in strawberry.
lore.legendary: Was shaken so hard on a school trip that it turned into butter, then cheese, then a very small cow.
